title: Characterizing Knowledge Manipulation in a Russian Wikipedia Fork

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative text analysis of article revisions between Russian Wikipedia and its state-aligned fork (Ruwiki). The methodology includes tracking added and deleted reference sources, using Named Entity Recognition (NER) to quantify modifications to locations and organizations, and applying LLM-based clustering to categorize edits related to territorial disputes, sanctions, and war terminology.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Unsupervised clustering of LLM-generated edit summaries to detect specific patterns of knowledge manipulation, revealing a distinct cluster of edits focused on altering or removing content related to LGBT rights, historical events, and notable figures.
